plan.brief:
Systematically optimize the engineering design of newspaper-crawler-py and fix real, reproducible defects on top of commit db78c68. Constraints: keep the existing Chinese CLI/help language and JSON field conventions; tests stay offline; one atomic commit per verified unit; do not push to GitHub without asking. Out of scope: rewriting the site registry, changing download semantics, or adding new newspapers.

- CLI failure contract: when crawl/plan has parsed successfully and then fails at runtime (resume with no ledger, resume with every ledger site gone, or an unexpected handler exception) under --json, stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=false and an error message, stderr keeps the human-readable message, the exit code stays 1, and no traceback is printed; successful JSON keeps its documented fields.
- Edition label and Markdown link integrity: an edition label must never repeat 第NN版 when a parser supplies a label-like name, and TOC link text must escape brackets so a title or edition name containing [ or ] cannot break the Markdown link; a live crawl of a real day must stay structurally unchanged.
- Legacy parser consolidation: remove the duplicated old-system article parsing in rmrb.py and gmrb.py by extracting one shared helper, prove behavior parity on both live old-system dates, and keep the full site suite green.

goals.title: CLI failure contract: when crawl/plan has parsed successfully and the...
goals.objective: CLI failure contract: when crawl/plan has parsed successfully and then fails at runtime (resume with no ledger, resume with every ledger site gone, or an unexpected handler exception) under --json, stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=false and an error message, stderr keeps the human-readable message, the exit code stays 1, and no traceback is printed; successful JSON keeps its documented fields.

successCriteria.scenario: With a pre-existing day file, run `python -m newspaper_crawler crawl --sites rmrb --start 2026-09-01 --end 2026-09-01 -o <tmp> --json --quiet` against a writable CRAWLER_STATE; stdout must be exactly one JSON object with ok=true and the documented keys sites/unknown_sites/start_date/end_date/output_dir/format/elapsed_secs/resumed/stats/files/skipped/errors/warnings, stats.days_skipped=1 and one skipped path.

With an empty CRAWLER_STATE, run `python -m newspaper_crawler crawl --resume --json` and `python -m newspaper_crawler plan --resume --json`; each must exit 1, write exactly one JSON object to stdout with ok=false and a non-empty error string, keep `没有可续传的任务` on stderr, and print no traceback.

In a Python harness, monkeypatch newspaper_crawler.cli.run_multi to raise RuntimeError('boom') and call main(['crawl','--sites','rmrb','--start','2026-09-01','--end','2026-09-01','-o',<tmp>,'--json','--quiet']); the return must be 1, stdout one JSON object with ok=false and an error containing 'boom', stderr a human message, and no traceback.
